deviations.item: Position-role token integer values are placed after the full baseline codebook and collision-extension range (base 768 + item count), rather than simply using 0..3.
deviations.reason: Avoids collisions with existing baseline SID token IDs while preserving every baseline token value. The role vocabulary remains four values.

deviations.item: Position-role statistics are estimated once from one longest train prefix per user, reconstructed as history + target, rather than treating every prefix-example row as a separate sequence.
deviations.reason: Stage 0 stores cumulative prefixes as next-item rows; counting every row would repeatedly count the same underlying user journey and distort the marginal position profile.

assumptions: The longest history row for each user, together with that row's target, represents that user's complete Stage 0 training sequence; all source rows are from train.parquet, and no validation/test rows are consulted.

For items with no counted occurrence, 'global-median bin' means assign the smoothed global mean mu0 using the same right-sided quartile cut convention; in the ordinary distinct-cut case this is the central bin.
Per-item mean-relative-position quartiles are computed over observed training items using NumPy's default linear quantile interpolation.

smoke.result: PASS: finite RQ-VAE forward and backward losses; finite, nonzero encoder gradient; position bins restricted to {0,1,2,3}; collision-extended baseline plus role token exports a five-column, unique SID matrix.

notes: Copied the frozen TIGER_RQ-VAE baseline tree. Training architecture, latent dimension 32, three 256-code levels, 3000 epochs, optimizer, schedule, batch size, seeds, train split, and baseline quantizer/export logic are unchanged. The additional position-role calculation is a training-only preprocessing pass and the frozen role vector is appended at export; it adds no per-step trainable parameters or optimization operations. Smoke used synthetic tensors and sequences; it did not run the full 3000-epoch training or Stage 3 evaluation.
